origin.details: Every element is painted red, including an empty string. Empty strings are not dropped. A missing value is drawn as the letters NA. The pillar options do not turn this off.
origin.value: A character vector of the same length.

translation.description: The same red. None is missing and is drawn as the letters NA. A string is one element and a list is the vector.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string, None, a number, or a list of those. An empty string is painted too.

translation.details: Red is always applied. There is no pillar option for it, and empty strings are kept. Set cli.num_colors first. One color pastes the text, so the letters NA come back with no codes. Otherwise the open code is ESC [ 31 m and the close code is ESC [ 39 m.
translation.value: A string when x is a single value, or a list when x is a list.
translation.example:
from cli._options import options as cli_options

cli_options(**{"cli.num_colors": 8})

from pillar.styles import style_na

print(style_na("NA"))
